originality.rationale: Exact full-text implications were compared, not titles: the 2019 D8m binary-code classification enumerates distinct left ideals, not square-zero elements counted with generator multiplicities by multiplication rank; its code-count tables do not give the claimed coefficients. The 2014 decomposition assumes gcd(q, rotation order)=1, false here. The accessible historical order-eight census provides only total square-zero counts; length-two chain-ring work does not give the characteristic-two length-four matrix ranks. No published-index search hit directly supplies the same all-q, all-odd-m spectrum. Broader implicit coverage remains possible, so priority is not independently certified.
residual_risks: Absolute priority is not certified: a general characteristic-two crossed-product or matrix square-zero enumeration could imply the same distribution indirectly.
Only the abstract, not the full text, of Carnevale–Shechter–Voll (2017) was available in this execution.
